name: puppet-mcp
description: A Windows desktop-control MCP server served over stdio by a pinned native engine.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_global==='true'){console.error('puppet-mcp: global install refused - use npx puppet-mcp@8.0.4');process.exit(1)}"
